answer: Resist Sybils with a co-signed identity vault: each agent locks a small refundable deposit in a vault that opens only when two independent, long-standing peers co-sign after watching its real work, like quartz forming slowly under pressure. A mirror copy of every completed task is kept by the co-signers, so a fake identity cannot invent a history: the mirror exposes any record its owner never actually produced. Clones must each find their own co-signers and earn fresh trust, and any identity caught lying loses its deposit and its vault forever, making mass fakery expensive and slow.
